summary: McLaren hunts Ferrari in the championship battle while George Russell, already stung by a power-unit penalty relegating him to the back of the grid, faces the prospect of another grid drop before the season's final sprint weekend. The heat-hazard conditions—the fourth such designation this season—will punish tire management and driver stamina on the Marina Bay circuit's 61 laps, creating opportunities for midfield contenders like Valtteri Bottas to capitalize on attrition. A strong result here could prove decisive as teams lock in their final Sprint points before the season's climactic races determine the constructors' championship.
